parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true and reside in the same test file 'Shared/Playback/Tests/RadioPlayerTests/RadioPlayerTests.swift'. Although the two methods — 'RadioPlayerTests.pauseStopsPlayback' (line 160) and 'RadioPlayerTests.pauseResetsStream' (line 181) — share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7778), they are distinct test cases verifying different observable behaviours of the pause operation: one asserts that playback stops, the other that the stream is reset. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-message clarity. Duplication in test fixtures at this level is intentional and idiomatic in XCTest.
